pages.text: The last ingot is not hard because of one rare thing - it is hard because of $(thing)how much$() goes into it. The $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$() is a 9x9 crafting grid; JEI's "+" button fills it for you.

The $(item)Singularity Compactor$() swallows thousands of one material and squeezes them into a $(item)Material Singularity$(): 2,048 netherite, 8,192 diamonds, 65,536 redstone... There is no timer - it absorbs as fast as you (or pipes, or AE2) feed it, and remembers its progress.

Lattices of $(item)Cherenkov Lattice$() and nether stars make the $(item)Crystalline Matrix Ingot$(). Four "everything" items take one of every meat, every crop, a ring of ender pearls, and every music disc. Yes, every disc. I went looking.
Day 340, tallying. The $(item)Omniscience Catalyst$() takes one of every material singularity, the conceptual singularities, the four everything-items and more - roughly 587,776 raw items each.

The $(item)Omnium Ingot$() needs 16 catalysts, 32 Cosmic Neutronium, 16 Crystalline Matrix and an Omega Point in the 9x9 table.$(br2)In bulk: with $(thing)cosmic neutronium coils$() the Conceptual Singularity Compressor forges one from 128 catalysts and stacks of the late metals; with $(thing)transfinite coils$(), 4 at a time from 128.
A metal made of every concept there is. The last ingot.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
Diamond and Cherenkov quartz woven around netherite: a frame for a crystal that should not exist.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
Lattices pinned in place by the light of two dead stars.$(br2)Made in $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
All nine singularities, fused. Holding it, you know everything - briefly.$(br2)Made in $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Extreme Assembly Table$(): Autonomous Extreme Assembler$(li)$(item)Omnium Ingot$(): Absolute Frame Casing, Apeiron Ingot, Axiom Key, Block of Omnium, Omnilex and more$(li)$(item)Cherenkov Lattice$(): Crystalline Matrix Ingot, Form of the Self$(li)$(item)Crystalline Matrix Ingot$(): Omniscience Catalyst, Omnium Ingot, Transfinite Weave$(li)$(item)Omniscience Catalyst$(): Omnium Ingot, Pleroma Confluence
